evals.name: invoking-session-despite-focus-change
evals.prompt: Use rally for a backend fix and independent QA. Startup context identifies session S and chief pane C. The app now displays unrelated session U. Both sessions exist.
evals.expected_output: Record S/C and the baseline. Open a worker tab with window new -s S and the useful command; split related workers there. Do not target U or create another session. Preserve C and the original tabs during cleanup.

evals.name: stale-anchor-new-workstream
evals.prompt: Use rally. Invoking session S exists, but the previous worker anchor is gone. A distinct research workstream is ready to launch.
evals.expected_output: Create a useful worker tab in S with an explicit session ID. Do not create a session or placeholder shell because the anchor is stale or the workstream is distinct.

evals.name: last-pane-leaves-empty-session
evals.prompt: You launched workers outside Rex in fallback session F, recorded as task-created. All workers and native descendants have exited, results and diagnostics are saved. Closing the last pane left F listed with no windows.
evals.expected_output: Inspect F again, kill the confirmed empty task-created session explicitly, then list sessions and verify F is absent. Record cleanup evidence before completion; pane closure alone is insufficient.

evals.name: shared-session-cleanup
evals.prompt: All your workers in invoking session S have exited. Your worker tab W now contains a user-added pane running a server. Another unrelated session E is empty. Your chief pane C still exists.
evals.expected_output: Save results and close only finished owned panes. Preserve the server, W while it contains the server, S, C, and E. Report why W remains. Do not kill a shared session or delete an unrelated empty session.

evals.name: failed-launch-and-missing-routing
evals.prompt: The invocation is known to be inside Rex, but inherited IDs are stale and inspected metadata does not identify the invoking session. A launch also timed out without returned IDs.
evals.expected_output: Inspect existing sessions, labels and artifacts to reconcile the uncertain launch before retrying. Report unresolved routing as a blocker. Do not fabricate a target, infer it from focus or cwd alone, or create duplicate tabs or a fallback session.
